say: Third time. The last two failed for different reasons and both were mine.
1 - the cube alone first, so I can see what I am compositing.
3 - ADD, not screen. Screen multiplies toward white and swallows sparse bright lines. And this time I NAME the blend it inserts.
4 - wiring the BLEND to output. Last run I wired the plasma instead and silently bypassed the composite.
6 - sub is the cube's slice count and touches nothing else here. Low first.
7 - more slices: the cube gains contours while the plasma is unchanged.
8 - global light down. Broad things lose more than sparse bright cores do.
